---
name: dreamers-clean-work
description: "Maintain improvements and identify stale workspace or project instructions between milestones."
---

$ARGUMENTS

Read [shared rules](../../instructions/dreamers.instructions.md) if not already loaded.

1. Read .dreamers/improvements.md. Apply straightforward authorized system-text fixes; close obsolete items, leaving open items with reasons and a next action.
2. Identify old .dreamers/{forge,probe,hone,sentinel,echo}/ artifacts. Recommend cleanup; do not delete historical artifacts automatically.
3. Compare open improvements, retros, project instructions, and recent default-branch history with current code. Propose instruction corrections for user selection; apply selected changes only. Clearly stale references to nonexistent files may be removed directly.
4. Report actioned, deferred, closed, and proposed items. No implementation pipeline or subagents.
